dedupe_keys.name: start field hospital medical staff planning instances spanish agency for international development cooperation emergency team

description: This data set holds the test instances and solutions of an optimisation model that plans which volunteer doctors, nurses and other staff to send to a field hospital deployed after a disaster abroad. The producers are Javier Martín-Campo, Teresa Ortuño and Berta Ruiz-González of the Universidad Complutense de Madrid, whose article concerns START, the Spanish emergency medical team field hospital. Coverage is one set of planning instances built around deployments of that field hospital. The data workbook lists general parameters, staffing demand by profile, prices, charter flights, the health profiles of volunteers, their availability and their grades; eight further workbooks give solutions for an infeasibility test, cost, availability and grade objectives, a single combined objective, two goal programming variants and compromise programming. The Excel files are available as a free download from Zenodo under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: the paper was submitted, not published when the data were deposited, personal data are presumably simplified, and one team's rules apply. Simulation uses: benchmarking staff rostering for emergency medical teams, testing how volunteer availability limits surge capacity in disaster response, and teaching multi-objective optimisation. Related records: the ambulance deployment dataset for Fez-Meknes (data-fez-meknes-ambulance-deployment) supports emergency resource location models.
